title: What Does RAM Actually Do? #Shorts
description:
What does RAM actually do? It's billions of tiny leaky buckets of charge, one per bit, and your computer refills every one of them about every 64 milliseconds. Pull the power and they all drain, which is why unsaved work vanishes. Plus the weird part: just reading a bucket empties it.

Explained in 60 #10

#ExplainedIn60 #HowThingsWork #RAM #Computer #Shorts
first_comment: Be honest: did you know reading your RAM empties the bucket every single time?
